mapper.insert: insert into user_achievements (user_id, achievement_id, obtained_time) values (#{userId}, #{achievementId}, #{time})
mapper.select: select achievement_id from user_achievements where user_id = #{userId}
select obtained_time from user_achievements where user_id = #{userId} and achievement_id = #{achievementId}
select count(*) from user_achievements where user_id = #{userId} and achievement_id = #{achievementId}
